_comment: Coverage ratchet baselines (#185), consumed by scripts/coverage_gate.py.
Values are whole percent, measured on main by the `coverage` CI job
(MODE=cov, gcc-14, Linux arm64, unit + int + e2e with both reference
models) and rounded DOWN. Raising after an improvement is routine;
lowering requires a justified, reviewed edit. null = not yet measured,
which the gate treats as a failure that prints the measured value.
floors are hard minimums outside the ratchet: src/io is the parser
security gate (malformed-GGUF surface) and must never dip below 35%.
